question: Seven times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 46 years. After 8 years, six times Q’s age will be 24 years less than six times P’s age at that time. What is the present age (in years) of Q?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The difference between two people's ages remains constant over time.

From the future condition: 6(Q + 8) = 6(P + 8) − 24

Dividing by 6 gives: Q + 8 = P + 8 − 4 ⇒ P − Q = 4

We are given the present age condition: 7P − Q = 46

Subtracting (P − Q = 4) from (7P − Q = 46) gives: 6P = 42 ⇒ P = 7

Substituting P gives: Q = 7 − 4 = 3 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Seven times the present age of P exceeds Q's present age by 46 years.

After 8 years, 6 times Q's age is 24 years less than 6 times P's age.
